basic.description:
{Basic Mysticism}

Basic Mysticism allows the hero to regenerate 20% of their maximum spell points per day, with a minimum of 5 spell points regenerated per day.

advanced.description:
{Advanced Mysticism}

Advanced Mysticism allows the hero to regenerate 35% of their maximum spell points per day, with a minimum of 10 spell points regenerated per day.

expert.description:
{Expert Mysticism}

Expert Mysticism allows the hero to regenerate 50% of their maximum spell points per day, with a minimum of 15 spell points regenerated per day.
